body.x: Before a worker steps into a hazardous zone, someone has to be sure there is no fire, gas or intruder waiting there. Sending a machine in first to check and record the scene keeps people out of harm's way.
LK ROBOTICS Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Enterprise Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for LKR-VisionX, an industrial safety orchestration system.

LKR-VisionX is an AI-native industrial safety system that unifies sensing, verification, decision-making and physical response on a single mobile platform. It integrates a motorized pan-and-tilt coaxial EO/IR head, four-direction around-view monitoring, LiDAR, and gas and acoustic sensing with on-device AI, and an onboard AI agent evaluates each event and converts the decision into Physical AI actions through the host platform.

Before workers enter a hazardous area, LKR-VisionX inspects the scene, verifies fire, gas, overheating, intrusion or dangerous proximity, and records structured evidence remotely. It then warns nearby workers, redirects the platform, restricts approach and escalates the event to the control room.
Its robot-agnostic design reduces blind spots, lowers integration cost and speeds response across multiple robot platforms.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
* AVING NEWS uses AI-assisted tools in its editorial process.
